{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
dedup_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that the deduplication worked: we should now have 800 unique patients
print("Number of unique patient_id after deduplication:", dedup_data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows after deduplication:", len(dedup_data))

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = dedup_data[dedup_data['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]
total_patients = len(dedup_data)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Number of patients with severe baseline disease: {severe_count}")
print(f"Total number of patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")

# Return the fraction as a float
fraction_severe"}
